title: BlindSense System
subtitle: Real-time wearable vision processing pipeline utilizing edge AI and haptic feedback loops.
description: BlindSense is a wearable belt that helps blind and visually impaired people navigate their surroundings. An onboard Raspberry Pi 5 runs YOLO segmentation to understand the walking path and obstacles, and translates what it sees into haptic feedback.

steps.label: 1st Version
steps.desc: Held by hope and prayer, in this version we were using normal controller and sensors.

steps.label: 2nd Version
steps.desc: Now with onboard RPi 5, the belt can think and process AI vision.

steps.label: Vision Stack
steps.desc: With YOLO segmentation, we are able to process the road walking path and obstacles.

steps.label: Huawei regional
steps.desc: This project was selected for the Huawei regional competition.

steps.label: CPIA
steps.desc: We won second place in CPIA competition.

title: Pestibot Platform
subtitle: Autonomous agricultural navigation rover designed for scanning target crop environments.
description: Pestibot uses AI vision to detect pests on crops and spray pesticide only where it is needed, cutting chemical use and cost for Cambodian farmers.

steps.label: Overview
steps.desc: This project uses AI to process and spray pesticides efficiently.

steps.label: AI vision
steps.desc: YOLO object detection used with fake pests.

steps.label: First design
steps.desc: This is the first ever design featuring just the bare minimum concept.

steps.label: Huawei success
steps.desc: This project earned us the Huawei regional grand prize and global 3rd prize.

title: Reanot System
subtitle: Application for students and teachers to find each other built to handle many users with small infrastructure cost.
description: Reanot connects students with teachers. Students can browse courses, find and contact teachers directly, or post a request when they can't find what they need.

steps.label: Course page
steps.desc: For students to find what they like.

steps.label: Teacher page
steps.desc: You can even find and contact teachers directly.

steps.label: Request page
steps.desc: Don't see what you want? Post a request!
